answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent’s signing key to an enclave that remote attestation verifies as running the approved MRENCLAVE; copying a VM cannot reproduce its hardware-protected key. With enrollment enforcing one identity per attested platform, an attacker must provision additional physical silicon, not merely duplicate software. The orchard of verified agents can thus expand toward the horizon only at real hardware cost, while each pearl-like identity remains tied to its attested enclave.
